role-user-desc: Such a user can only access the trackers that are in the dealer's account and work with them within the scope of their permissions. They can use commands or view data if allowed, and their ability to work with logs and configuration is limited by the settings set by the admin.
role-dealer-desc: An admin (level 2) or dealer has full access to all trackers added to their account. They can create their own users and assign access rights to trackers, including the ability to configure and view data logs. This role allows them to manage their part of the infrastructure independently of the superadmin, but within the limits of the designated trackers.
role-support-desc: It is created by a superadmin and can work with trackers that have been granted access to it. You can add trackers to dealers, create second-level admins, and use the system's features within the assigned permissions. Access to data logs and the ability to configure trackers depend on the permissions granted by the superadmin.
role-superadmin-desc: A user with maximum rights in the system. Manages all trackers, has access to their configuration and commands, as well as to device logs (depending on the settings: no, only viewing or full access). A superadmin can create their own users, second-level admins (dealers), and transfer trackers from their account to dealer accounts. You determine the level of access to data and configuration for all lower-level roles.
